ms.promise:
The current implementation of the code to build transactions has three components: the backend transaction builder, a minting signature bot and the frontend adapter for partial transactions. These components make use of the deprecated library Bot Plutus Interface. The main purpose of this milestone is to simplify the design by unifying the code for building transactions and also moving away from unmaintained libraries. Our first option is to use Atlas, as we believe it will provide the easiest migration path given the state of our current implementation.
As such, the output of Milestone 1 is:
・Refactored code for building transactions that uses Atlas (or an alternative maintained library) and has a simplified architecture with less components.
ms.criteria: The new transaction builder is capable of submitting all the relevant kinds of transactions for Kwarxs to the Cardano testnet (preprod or preview). Specifically, it is capable of performing the two main user actions: minting the NFTs giving rights to receive a share of the shared profits and claiming the portion of rewards to which the NFT holder is entitled.

ms.promise:
Following the refactor in Milestone 1, the code will be in a good position to support future versions of Cardano, including the upcoming Conway era. In this milestone, the transaction builder will be adapted to be compatible with the Sancho network, which is the beacon for the Conway era. Once transactions submitted to the Sancho network are accepted, the code will be prepared to run smoothly even post Chang hard-fork.
As such, the output of Milestone 2 is:
・Transaction builder that supports building transactions compatible with the Conway era.
ms.criteria:
・The new transaction builder is capable of submitting all the relevant kinds of transactions for Kwarxs to the Sancho Network, the testnet supporting Cardano’s Conway era. Specifically, it is capable of performing the two main user actions: minting the NFTs giving rights to receive a share of the shared profits and claiming the portion of rewards to which the NFT holder is entitled.

Note that in the event that Milestone 2 is submitted after the Chang hardfork has taken place, submitting transactions to the preview network will be considered equivalent to submitting them to the Sancho Network.

ms.report:
:: RESPONSES ::
Response to reviewer 1

> it does not clearly display claimable rewards, as stated in the evidence of milestone completion

Please try the following steps to view claimable rewards:
1. Go to https://preview--kwarxs.netlify.app/marketplace
2. Purchase one or more “TEST REWARDABLE NFT” NFTs.
3. Wait a minute or so for your wallet to pick up the transaction and then go to https://preview--kwarxs.netlify.app/your-nfts
4. Look for the “TEST REWARDABLE NFT” collection you purchased. You will see the ADA rewards listed on the card, along with a button to claim the rewards.

Note that this is testnet and the reward pools have been posted on chain ahead of time for testing purposes. On mainnet, these rewards will be distributed over time and thus we cannot display claimable rewards up front on the site. They become claimable at a later time. 

Instead, buyers see the APY listed on the NFT they are about to purchase.
> How is the APY determined?
The APY is determined based on revenue generated through our network of wholly-owned subsidiaries under the Kwarxs Corporation (Dubai). These subsidiaries operate across multiple jurisdictions to optimize revenue generation. Profits are aggregated globally, converted into ADA or Cardano's stablecoin (USDM), and allocated to the Energy Reward Pool (NFT burning mechanism) for redistribution to holders.
> What are the specific revenue sources backing these rewards?
Key Revenue Mechanisms:
・Solar Energy Sales: Direct sales of solar-generated electricity to municipalities, governments, utilities, and brokers, priced on a per-kilowatt basis.
・Real-World Asset Integration: Solar installations within our verified asset portfolio will stream live performance data via API to our upcoming platform (in development), ensuring real-time transparency.

All revenues are converted transparently into $ADA/USDM and pooled for reward distribution. Annual audited financial statements for each subsidiary will be published post-fiscal year,

ms.promise:
This milestone focuses on the auxiliary services that need to be integrated with Kwarxs in order to operate the application.
One of these services to be integrated is the KYC provider Blockpass. The integration with Blockpass will allow Kwarxs to verify the identity of the NFT buyers.
Also, the NFT metadata such as associated images and videos will be pre-processed and hosted in IPFS.
As such, the outputs of Milestone 4 are:
・Robust integration with Blockpass.
・Pre-processing of NFT images and videos, propagating IPFS links to the database to be used by the minting bot.
ms.criteria:
・Users interacting with the frontend can submit transactions to interact with the Kwarxs on-chain scripts only when using addresses verified by Blockpass.
・Users that have not passed KYC with Blockpass interacting with the front-end are redirected to verify their identity with Blockpass.
・The database is populated with all the necessary information and metadata related to the initial mintable collections, consisting of more than 10,000 NFTs.
